<!--
<noinclude>{{Documentation subpage}}</noinclude>
{{tsh|User RefDiff}}

This [[Wikipedia:Userboxes|userbox]] template identifies users who patrol diffs and review citations using the [[User:Powercycler/RefDiff|RefDiff]] user script, which decouples inline citation templates from prose in MediaWiki's diff view ({{mono|Special:Diff}}) to eliminate [[Wikipedia:Template camouflage|template camouflage]].

== Usage ==

=== Quick usage ===
Place the following wikitext on your user page (or inside a {{tlx|Userboxtop}} stack):

<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{User RefDiff}}
</syntaxhighlight>

=== Live preview ===
{{Userbox
| border-c = #d4a017
| border-s = 1
| id-c     = #fffdf0
| id-fc    = #9a6700
| id-s     = 11
| id       = <span style="font-family: monospace, 'Courier New', Courier; font-size: 1.15em; font-weight: bold; color: #9a6700; background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.25); border: 1px solid rgba(218, 165, 32, 0.5); padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; display: inline-block;">⟨~ref~⟩</span>
| info-c   = #ffffff
| info-fc  = #202122
| info-s   = 8
| info-lh  = 1.25em
| info     = This user reviews diffs and combats [[Wikipedia:Template camouflage|template camouflage]] with '''[[User:Powercycler/RefDiff|RefDiff]]'''.
| nocat    = yes
}}
